subject.title: Support session-level environment variables for ACP sessions

question: Should OpenClaw expose a per-spawn `sessions_spawn.env` map for ACP sessions, and if so what credential boundary should govern it?
rationale: The requested API can carry secrets into host ACP harness subprocesses and overlaps with open per-agent and per-call env designs, so implementation should not proceed until maintainers choose the permanent boundary.

options.title: Design a constrained per-spawn ACP env contract
options.body: Allow the capability only with explicit validation, blocked key filtering, redaction, docs, and tests across tool schema, ACP manager, ACPX, and session reuse.

options.title: Route callers to configured per-agent env
options.body: Treat per-spawn env as too risky and let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96229 or its successor cover operator-configured subprocess env instead.

options.title: Defer to broader per-call secret injection design
options.body: Keep this issue open behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80329 until the trusted-caller secret delivery model is chosen.

recommendation.title: Design a constrained per-spawn ACP env contract
recommendation.body: Allow the capability only with explicit validation, blocked key filtering, redaction, docs, and tests across tool schema, ACP manager, ACPX, and session reuse.

likelyOwner.reason: The question is product/security policy for an ACP and credential boundary, and steipete has adjacent merger/reviewer history plus issue discussion routing.
